# Debrief: Argo CD, cert-manager, Envoy, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, Istio, Kubernetes

These clips cover Argo CD at scale and its pitfalls, Istio's sidecar-to-ambient evolution and production lessons, and cert-manager's project direction, all relevant to this Kubernetes GitOps and mesh stack. ([Declarative...ish? Fixing Hidden Argo CD Pitfalls in Your GitOps Setup · 16:45](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VfVQj4Oa3z0&t=1005s); [Evolution or Revolution: Istio as the Network Platform for Cloud Native · 4:24](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4K6s5y8HoBc&t=264s); [Istio in Production: Expected Value, Results, and Effort at GitHub Scale · 21:18](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2fXwQylR2lw&t=1278s); [Cert-manager – Project Update: Beyond 2026 · 0:00](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vzBGkY_HIyM&t=0s))

## Top 3 takeaways

1. Istio's move from per-pod Envoy sidecars to a per-node Ztunnel was driven by resource use and upgrade pain: sidecars required restarting every pod and showed poorly in the Kubernetes API. ([Evolution or Revolution: Istio as the Network Platform for Cloud Native · 4:24](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4K6s5y8HoBc&t=264s))
2. Moving to Istio ambient has side effects: cert-manager's ACME resolver needs an experimental feature enabled, and Argo Rollouts traffic management needs the Gateway API plugin configured. ([The Good, The Ugly, and The Bad: Leaving Sidecars Behind with Istio Ambient Mesh · 21:59](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ToKv7JntLvY&t=1319s))
3. Writing individual Argo CD Applications is called an anti-pattern: one ApplicationSet can replace 50 apps (five infrastructure tools across ten clusters), though differing configurations require planning how to categorize clusters. ([Declarative...ish? Fixing Hidden Argo CD Pitfalls in Your GitOps Setup · 16:45](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VfVQj4Oa3z0&t=1005s))

## Action items

- [ ] Audit your Argo CD repos for hand-written per-cluster Application manifests, and prototype replacing them with an ApplicationSet covering cert-manager, Prometheus and Istio. ([Declarative...ish? Fixing Hidden Argo CD Pitfalls in Your GitOps Setup · 16:45](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VfVQj4Oa3z0&t=1005s))
- [ ] Before evaluating Istio ambient, list the cert-manager ACME and Argo Rollouts traffic-management dependencies you would need to change, including enabling experimental features and the Gateway API plugin. ([The Good, The Ugly, and The Bad: Leaving Sidecars Behind with Istio Ambient Mesh · 21:59](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ToKv7JntLvY&t=1319s))
- [ ] If you try Argo CD pull-request previews, use a dedicated Argo CD instance rather than production, since the preview process can overload and crash the production instance. ([Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 8:41](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=521s))

## Watch together (9 min)

1. [The Good, The Ugly, and The Bad: Leaving Sidecars Behind with Istio Ambient Mesh · 21:59](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ToKv7JntLvY&t=1319s) (1:21), Alfonso Ming, Jorge Turrado: Ambient mesh impact on cert-manager and Argo Rollouts, directly our stack.
2. [Evolution or Revolution: Istio as the Network Platform for Cloud Native · 4:24](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4K6s5y8HoBc&t=264s) (1:25), Mitch Connors, Daniel Grimm: Explains why Istio moved from sidecars to Ztunnel.
3. [Declarative...ish? Fixing Hidden Argo CD Pitfalls in Your GitOps Setup · 16:45](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VfVQj4Oa3z0&t=1005s) (1:22), Regina Voloshin: Concrete ApplicationSet advice covering cert-manager, Prometheus and Istio.
4. [Istio in Production: Expected Value, Results, and Effort at GitHub Scale · 21:18](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2fXwQylR2lw&t=1278s) (2:18), Mitch Connors, Golnaz Rouhi: Istio production lessons: ambient multicluster, Gateway API, deny-by-default.
5. [Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 8:41](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=521s) (2:21), Dag Bjerre Andersen, Sergey Shevchenko: Warns against running PR previews on production Argo CD.
